name: Comparative & World Literature: Comparative Literature, BALAS

groups.note: Composition I Advanced Composition Humanities & the Arts (6 hours) fulfilled by CWL 202 and any other course approved as Humanities & the Arts Natural Sciences & Technology (6 hours) Social & Behavioral Sciences (6 hours) Cultural Studies: Non-Western Cultures (1 course) Cultural Studies: US Minority Cultures (1 course) Cultural Studies: Western/Comparative Cultures (1 course) fulfilled by CWL 202 Quantitative Reasoning (2 courses, at least one course must be Quantitative Reasoning I) Language Requirement (Completion of the fourth semester or equivalent of a language other than English, or completion of the third semester in two different languages other than English is required)

groups.label: Language: A minimum of 6 hours of advanced language at the 200-400 level (may be satisfied with a proficiency exam)
Five core CWL courses chosen from broadly comparative courses, from the following:

courses.title: Special Topics in Comp Lit II

groups.note: At least two courses must be at the 300- 400-level. At least one course must be in a period prior to 1800 and one course in a period since 1800.

groups.label: Major Literature Coursework- Three courses in a major literature, taught in the orignial language, at 200-400-level. No more than 2 courses at the 200-level.
Focus Area Coursework - At least two courses from one of the following focus areas, at 200-400 level. No more than 1 course at the 200-level:
groups.note: Minor Literature: courses in a second national literature, taught in the original language. Interdisciplinary: courses in another discipline, such as philosophy, cinema, art history, fine arts, music, religion, science, medical humanities, law, creative writing Cultural Studies: courses with a focus on race, gender, class, postcolonialism, environmental studies, or the like Area Studies: courses in a geographical area related to major literature (Africa, Middle East, Latin America, South Asia, East Asia, Eastern Europe, the European Union).
